Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts (about 400 words), part of HEALTH – COMMUNICABLE DISEASES Suggested Vocabulary: virus, hygiene, bacteria, t in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How do you describe things? 2. How can you tell what will happen in a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts (about 400 words) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility is developed as the learner reads texts which feature these values and watches a video related to the theme.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Health Education is enhanced as the learner is exposed to information on communicable diseases.

• Environmental Education is developed as the learner reads texts about diseases.

Link to other Subjects:

The learner can apply the knowledge obtained from reading texts on communicable diseases to other learning areas like

Physical and Health Education.
